server.name: io.github.cedricziel/truenas-mcp
server.description: Inspect and manage TrueNAS SCALE storage, shares, apps and system state with your own API key
server.title: TrueNAS SCALE

headers.description: Your own TrueNAS API key as `Bearer <key>`. Create it under Credentials -> API Keys. The server stores no credential; the session reaches exactly what this key permits.
headers.name: Authorization

runtimeArguments.description: Bind the MCP listener to loopback only. Plaintext is enabled below on the assumption that nothing off-host can reach it.
runtimeArguments.name: --publish

environmentVariables.description: TrueNAS host to manage, optionally `host:port`. Requires TrueNAS SCALE 25.04 or later.
environmentVariables.name: TRUENAS_MCP_TARGET

environmentVariables.description: Serve MCP without TLS. Set here because the listener is published on loopback only; drop it and supply TRUENAS_MCP_TLS_CERT/KEY if the port is reachable from elsewhere.
environmentVariables.name: TRUENAS_MCP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT

environmentVariables.description: Accept the TrueNAS certificate unverified while keeping the connection encrypted. TrueNAS ships a self-signed certificate for `CN=localhost`, so no address you can reach it by will validate.
environmentVariables.name: TRUENAS_MCP_TARGET_INSECURE

environmentVariables.description: Expose the mutating tools. Read-only by default; unrecoverable operations stay unreachable either way.
environmentVariables.name: TRUENAS_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
